deskyard volume list: list the volumes

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] volume list [--json]

Lists the volumes (shared folders in the server's data folder, mounted at
/share/NAME) and the computers they are granted to.

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text
  --server NAME        the server to manage (see `deskyard server list`);
                       default: the server -c SERVER/COMPUTER names, else the
                       default server

Prints: a table NAME COMPUTERS FOLDER CREATED; with --json the API's answer
  {volumes:[Volume]}

Examples:
  deskyard volume list

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
